entry.title: Selected for the 74th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting

link.title: Selected for the 74th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting

entry.content:
I was honored to be selected as one of 30 Chinese PhD students to attend the 74th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting (Chemistry), an international forum that brings Nobel Laureates together with early-career researchers.

Highlights of the Experience:

  • German University Tour: Prior to the meeting, I joined the Chinese delegation on visits to the University of Bonn, the University of Giessen, the University of Bayreuth, and the Technical University of Munich, where I toured the research facilities and learned how laboratories there are organized and run.
  • Scientific Exchange: During the meeting, I met and spoke with several Nobel Laureates. One memorable moment was joining Professor Ben Feringa for an on-stage “arm-wrestling” demonstration that vividly illustrated how molecular machines convert light into mechanical motion.

The week gave me a broader perspective on the field and strengthened my commitment to rigorous research in physical organic chemistry.
entry.summary: Participating in the 74th Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting and visiting research universities across Germany.

entry.title: Oral Presentation Prize at ACS Spring 2025

link.title: Oral Presentation Prize at ACS Spring 2025

entry.content:
I presented in the Virtual Graduate Students Symposium in Asia-Pacific Region on Synthetic Chemistry, held as part of ACS Spring 2025.

Presentation Details:

  • Topic: Overestimated halogen atom transfer reactivity of α-aminoalkyl radicals.
  • Core Discussion: The talk focused on the quantitative kinetic characterization of α-aminoalkyl radicals and the substantial overestimation of their reactivity in halogen atom transfer (XAT) processes.

Following the session, I was honored to receive the Oral Presentation Prize, reflecting our group’s ongoing work on the fundamental kinetics of open-shell intermediates.
entry.summary: Presenting research on halogen atom transfer (XAT) reactivity at the ACS Spring 2025 Virtual Graduate Students Symposium.

entry.title: Outstanding Presentation Award at the 5th Beijing–Tianjin Organic Chemistry Symposium

link.title: Outstanding Presentation Award at the 5th Beijing–Tianjin Organic Chemistry Symposium

entry.content:
The 5th Beijing–Tianjin Graduate Student Organic Chemistry Symposium was held at Nankai University, bringing together approximately 300 students from Tsinghua University, Peking University, the Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICCAS), and Nankai University.

Key Achievements:

  • Oral Presentation: I gave a talk on my recent progress in studying transient radical intermediates, highlighting how direct kinetic measurements clarify complex reaction mechanisms.
  • Recognition: Based on votes from faculty attendees across the participating institutions, I received the Outstanding Presentation Award.

This symposium provided an excellent venue for academic exchange and a broad view of current research across the Beijing–Tianjin organic chemistry community.
entry.summary: Awarded for an oral presentation at the regional organic chemistry symposium held at Nankai University.
